llm.summary: The skill is internally consistent: it documents and delegates searches to the Voidtools Everything CLI/API, only requires the ev binary, and its instructions and examples match the stated purpose.

dimensions.detail: Name/description, required binary (ev), OS restriction (win32), and provided interfaces (CLI, Python API, MCP) line up with a Windows Everything-based file-search helper. Nothing requested (no cloud credentials, no unrelated binaries or config paths) is out of scope for a file-search tool.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The SKILL.md and bundled docs consistently instruct the agent to run searches, list and count files, and optionally read file contents or write search results to disk (examples include collecting .env files and exporting results.json). Those actions are coherent with a file-search skill but are capable of locating and reading sensitive files if the user asks — exercise caution when requesting content extraction.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: This is an instruction-only skill with no install spec in the registry; it suggests installing the referenced pip package in documentation but nothing in the skill forces a download/execute during install. Low install-surface risk.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no required environment variables or credentials. The docs show an optional $EVERYTHING_INSTANCE env var as an example for selecting an instance — harmless but referenced. No unexplained secrets or unrelated env variables are requested.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always:false and user-invocable:true. The skill does not request persistent or elevated platform privileges, nor does it attempt to modify other skills or system-wide agent settings.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to do what it says: it wraps Voidtools Everything for fast Windows file searches. Before using: 1) ensure Voidtools Everything (the actual service) and a legitimate ev binary are installed from trusted sources; the skill itself does not ask for credentials. 2) Be aware that the examples explicitly show locating files that commonly contain secrets (e.g., .env) and writing results to disk — do not ask the agent to search for or transmit sensitive files unless you intend that. 3) If you plan to install the optional pip package, inspect the package on PyPI (or its source) first. 4) If you will allow autonomous agent actions, remember the agent could run wide searches and read file contents when prompted — limit autonomy or scope when needed.
